verdict.rationale: Jules documents plan-tiered daily task limits (e.g., 'Power users & agent-heavy workflows ... 300 ... 60') and community reports confirm concrete limit numbers and changes (free plan cut from 60 to 15 daily tasks), showing limits exist and are plan-based. However, there is no evidence of an engineering-lead-facing dashboard or admin console to view/manage concurrency or team-wide usage—only a static usage-limits doc page and individual user complaints.
